assets.name: Infantry
assets.description: Modern US soldier in desert camo, low-poly style. Carrying a rifle, tactical vest and helmet. Dominant colors: Tan, olive green.

assets.name: Tank
assets.description: Modern main battle tank similar to M1 Abrams. Low-poly, desert tan color, rotating turret with a long cannon barrel.

assets.name: Artillery
assets.description: Mobile self-propelled howitzer. Tracked vehicle with a large elevating gun turret. Desert tan camouflage.

assets.name: CommandCenter
assets.description: Large concrete base structure with satellite dishes and antennas on top. Military command post aesthetic. Tan and grey colors.

assets.name: Barracks
assets.description: Low-poly military barracks building. Rectangular structure with corrugated metal roof and sandbags near the entrance.

assets.name: Factory
assets.description: Industrial war factory with large doors for vehicles. Flat roof with pipes and small chimneys. Concrete and metal textures.

assets.name: SupplyDepot
assets.description: Military supply warehouse. Contains crates and barrels outside. Simple metal structure with loading dock.

assets.name: Grass_Texture
assets.description: Stylized seamless grass texture for terrain. Vibrant green with slight variations in shade.

assets.name: Sand_Texture
assets.description: Desert sand seamless texture. Warm yellowish-tan color with subtle wind ripples.

assets.name: Road_Texture
assets.description: Dark asphalt road texture with white or yellow dashed lines in the middle.

assets.name: UI_Icons
assets.description: Set of flat minimalist UI icons for units and buildings. White silhouette on transparent background.

assets.name: Minimap_Icons
assets.description: Tiny circle and square icons for minimap representation. Colored by faction (Blue/Red/Green).
